description: Three shelves of salvaged fiction, sorted by a system that is clearly personal and clearly rigorous. The spines have been repaired with tape, thread, and in two cases what appears to be surgical adhesive. Somebody has pencilled a short verdict inside the front cover of each one — "bleak, correct", "funny until it isn't", "he saw all of this coming and nobody thanked him". The good ones are at eye level. The ones the librarian disapproves of are on the bottom shelf, face down.
name: shelves of salvaged fiction
